description: Shared Renovate ground for every datahub-local repository. A repository extends this and keeps only its own customManagers, includePaths and local policy. ignorePaths replaces the value config:recommended inherits rather than merging with it, so the inherited globs are repeated here and a repository that sets its own must list every glob it wants. The age gate is timestamp-optional because GHCR, Quay and ECR publish no release timestamp, and a timestamp-required gate holds their digest updates forever.

packageRules.description: A major gets its own branch per datasource so it is never approved alongside a patch nobody read.
Lock file maintenance delegates to the package manager, so there is no release timestamp to age against and the branch would stay pending forever.
